truth: the types/servlet-write.md template verbatim (CSRF token, target resolved with the caller's
Context, permission on the TARGET, OPERATOR flag) reports nothing.
-- args --
@DIR@/m
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- m/BPanelServlet.java --
public final class BPanelServlet extends BWebServlet {
  @Override
  public void doPost(WebOp op) throws Exception {
    try {
      CsrfUtil.verifyCsrfToken(op.getRequest());
    } catch (CsrfException e) {
      op.getResponse().sendError(403);
      return;
    }
    BComponent target = (BComponent) BOrd.make(ordParam(op)).resolve(Sys.getStation(), op).get();
    Property prop = target.getProperty(op.getRequest().getParameter("slot"));
    if (!requireTargetWrite(target, prop, op)) {
      op.getResponse().sendError(403);
      return;
    }
    target.set(prop, BDouble.make(value(op)), op);
  }

  static boolean requireTargetWrite(BComponent target, Property prop, Context cx) {
    if (cx == null || cx.getUser() == null || prop == null) return false;
    if (!target.getPermissions(cx).hasOperatorWrite()) return false;
    return (target.getFlags(prop) & Flags.OPERATOR) != 0;
  }
}
